source_snapshot.procedure: Run `dmidecode --type 25` under the OS to read SMBIOS Type 25.
source_snapshot.criteria: Information should match the SPEC definition.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek selects the correct type but pipes it through `grep -A1`, which can omit most of the five scheduled-power-on fields, suppresses stderr, uses unsafe SSH options and invents persistence-after-reboot judgment not present in the source.

original_test_intent.purpose: Read the intended server's complete SMBIOS Type 25 System Power Controls structure under the OS and compare its Next Scheduled Power-on fields with the applicable SMBIOS format and owner-approved platform specification.
original_test_intent.target: The SMBIOS table published by the selected SUT firmware, specifically Type 25 with its month, day-of-month, hour, minute and second fields.
original_test_intent.scope: One read-only `dmidecode --type 25` capture and comparison. The row does not set a power-on schedule, power-cycle the SUT, wait for a scheduled boot or test persistence across reboot.
original_test_intent.operation: Verify host/BIOS/SMBIOS/tool identity, run the source command without a truncating filter, capture stdout/stderr/exit status, parse every Type 25 instance and all five BCD schedule fields, validate the standard structure/ranges and compare raw/decoded values with the product specification without actuating power.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 10 attended and 10 machine minutes and specifies one OS read.
original_test_intent.expected_result: When the platform specification requires Type 25, the complete structure is present with length 09h and all five fields decode or are handled as out-of-range/unspecified values per DSP0134, and raw/decoded values match the approved platform schedule definition. Structure presence describes timed power-on availability but does not prove an actual scheduled boot occurred.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT, BIOS and SMBIOS versions; dmidecode version and timestamp; full stdout/stderr and exit status; each Type 25 handle; structure type/length when available; raw and decoded Month/Day/Hour/Minute/Second; validity/contribution handling; platform expectation comparison; no-mutation audit.
ambiguities: The source does not supply the expected Type 25 presence or field values.
DeepSeek's `grep -A1` can hide four or more required schedule fields.
DeepSeek adds persistence-after-reboot even though no reboot or second read exists in the source.
The source asks to clear logs even though no event generation is required.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly keeps the query read-only, requires complete output and owner specification, and prevents power actuation. It describes a broad power-control capability/field matrix and optional BMC cross-check instead of naming Type 25's exact five scheduled-power-on BCD fields and their out-of-range calculation rule, which risks accepting unrelated power evidence.

applicable_history.decision: Historical YES confirms direct collection is executable. It does not supply the missing SPEC or authorize a reboot/power-control behavior test.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2's class and read-only boundary, but make Type 25 evidence byte/field-specific: one 09h structure with five BCD schedule fields and explicit invalid-field handling. Exclude power actuation and reboot persistence from this row.

available_now: The source command and standard Type 25 layout are known and read-only.
Actual raw/decoded values can be collected even before the owner supplies expected values.
Standard structural/range checks do not require a DUT-specific schedule.
missing_inputs: The platform owner must state whether Type 25 is required and the expected raw/decoded scheduled-power-on values or allowed unspecified pattern for this BIOS configuration.
Runtime protected OS access and a qualified dmidecode version/parser are normal package inputs.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BIOS/platform owner supplies the Type 25 expectation; the automation/package owner supplies protected OS access and validates the parser.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect complete actual Type 25 output, all five raw/decoded fields and standard validity results without waiting for the SPEC.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not filter away fields, suppress errors, set a schedule, power-cycle/reboot, claim persistence, clear logs, interpret Type 25 as general power capabilities or declare PASS without the platform expectation.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Receive the owner-approved presence/value matrix, verify exact host/firmware, capture complete output, validate all five fields and compare each raw/decoded value with documented handling of out-of-range fields.

revision_candidate.test_name: SMBIOS Type 25 Next Scheduled Power-on Field Validation
revision_candidate.purpose: Read and validate the complete SMBIOS Type 25 scheduled-power-on structure against DSP0134 and the target BIOS specification without changing system power or schedule state.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server BIOS/SMBIOS implementation and OS exposing firmware tables to a qualified `dmidecode` reader.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every Type 25 instance and its Month, Day-of-month, Hour, Minute and Second bytes from one read. Actual scheduled boot behavior and persistence are outside scope.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Verified SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS and dmidecode versions; protected OS access; complete-output parser; owner-approved Type 25 presence and field expectations including allowed unspecified values; protected evidence storage.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Run `dmidecode --type 25` once on the verified SUT and preserve unfiltered stdout, stderr and exit status. Parse every System Power Controls structure and all five Next Scheduled Power-on fields. Validate Type 25/length 09h where raw structure data is available, BCD ranges, and DSP0134 handling of out-of-range fields; compare raw and decoded values with the platform specification. Do not actuate power or modify a schedule.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct host/BIOS and SMBIOS version verified; reader/parser qualified; expected presence/values supplied for final verdict; credentials protected; logs preserved; no concurrent firmware update.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version/timestamp; complete command stdout/stderr/exit status; each structure handle; type/length where available; raw and decoded five fields; range/contribution analysis; per-field platform comparison; explicit statement that no schedule or power behavior was exercised.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: DMTF SMBIOS Specification DSP0134 version 3.10.0 section 7.26/Table 94 and 7.26.1, constrained by the SMBIOS version implemented by the target and the owner-approved BIOS Type 25 expectation.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Read only. Do not set RTC/BIOS/BMC schedules, reboot or power-cycle, clear logs, expose credentials, hide stderr, truncate the structure or infer successful scheduled power-on from table contents.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: None for authorized read-only collection. The BIOS owner supplies and judges platform-specific presence/value expectations.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent can collect and structurally validate all fields and compare a supplied matrix. The engineer determines whether an out-of-range/unspecified pattern is intended for the active BIOS configuration.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No target recovery is expected. On missing/malformed output, preserve full evidence and stop interpretation; resolve target, firmware, access, reader or expectation before one bounded reread.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong host/firmware; credential exposure; inaccessible SMBIOS; nonzero/hidden command error; truncated output; malformed structure; ambiguous target SMBIOS version; missing platform expectation for final verdict; or any proposed schedule/power mutation.

identified_defects: DeepSeek truncates the complete Type 25 payload and suppresses errors.
DeepSeek invents persistence-after-reboot outside source scope.
V2 does not name the exact five BCD fields or invalid-field calculation rule.
The product-specific expected values are absent.
reason_for_change: Replace broad power-control wording with the exact scheduled-power-on structure so the agent collects every source-required field without turning a one-read SMBIOS check into a power actuation or persistence test.

new_technical_evidence.title: SMBIOS Specification
new_technical_evidence.applicability: SMBIOS Type 25 implementations, constrained by the target's advertised SMBIOS version
new_technical_evidence.supports: Type 25 length is 09h and contains exactly five BCD Next Scheduled Power-on fields. Presence implies a timed power-on facility. Out-of-range date/time fields do not contribute to the calculated interval; table content does not itself execute or prove a scheduled boot.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The target BIOS requirement and intended field values/unspecified pattern are not supplied.

removed_ambiguities: Defines Type 25 as scheduled-power-on data rather than generic power capabilities.
Lists all five fields and their validation role.
Separates structure correctness from actual scheduled-boot behavior and reboot persistence.
resolved_blockers: Complete Actual Value collection and normative structure checking can proceed before the platform expected values arrive.
remaining_blockers: Final PASS/FAIL comparison requires the owner-approved Type 25 presence and five-field expectation.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 makes the contract conform to the current normative Type 25 layout, eliminates invented reboot/power behavior and ensures no field is hidden by the historical filter.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The unchanged class and field-specific contract are queued for the next isolated batch.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 1548 runs one `dmidecode --type 25` read and compares information to SPEC.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 preserves full output and safety but omits the exact five scheduled-power-on field semantics.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow complete read-only Type 25 capture and parsing; prohibit schedule/power mutation, reboot/persistence expansion and truncated evidence.
